QuestInfo.name: Asking After Athena Pierce
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p221##k. Let's go see how #p221# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p221#, the leader of the archers. I'm glad to see she is doing well!

0.0: "I wonder how #p221# is doing lately. They often overexert themselves for the sake of the town. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Ah, you must be #h0#. Is there something I can help you with? Wait... you just came to see how I was doing...?
1.1: To be completely honest... leading the archers here can be quite exhausting at times, but having someone come all this way just to check on me brings a lot of comfort to my heart. Thank you. I won't forget how important it is to take care of myself as well.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
